title: Chip startup Bolt Graphics seeking to raise $100 million at about a $700 million valuation
key_facts: Bolt Graphics is seeking about $100 million at roughly a $700 million valuation, according to three people familiar with the matter (Reuters).
The funding talks are ongoing and amount and valuation could change; the lead investors are unknown.
Bolt is designing a graphics chip to compete with Nvidia and AMD, aimed at non-AI uses such as supercomputer calculations and videogame graphics.
This week Bolt finished first-round testing of its Zeus GPU architecture, aimed at physics simulation; the final chip is planned at TSMC.
CEO Darwesh Singh declined to comment on terms but said fundraising is 'well under way'.
Investors put about $10.7 billion into chip startups in the first five months of 2026 (Crunchbase), on pace to beat $12.2 billion for all of 2025.
